question: Two identical circles intersect each other such that each passes through the centre of the other. Length of common chord is 16sqrt{3} cm. What is the radius of each circle?
solution:
Given:

The length of common chrod is 16√3

Calculation:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/81330b9fa22b9dc3ae184a32efee8872aaa67b0a273be5796646776b7c5a3506.png] 

According to the diagram,

AD = DB

Let,

O1O2 = 2x

Again O1A = O2A = 2x [Radius of the circle]

∠ADO1 = 90°

O1D = O2D = 2x/2 = x

8√3 = √(4x² - x²)

⇒ 8√3 = √3x

x = 8

Radius = 2x = 16

∴ The length of the radius is 16 cm.
